messages:
anya: Noticing a weird spike in provision/deprov failures for a couple customers after last night's OIDC client rotation. UI shows 403 from IdP during deprov, and our logs show KMS signature verify errors for the extid token. Anyone else seeing this?

raj: I saw alerts earlier. Can you paste the log snippets? 403 + KMS verify sounds like either client secret mismatch or token was re-signed with a different key id.

anya: Snips: 
```
2026-03-23T01:02:10Z WARN scim.deprovision: idp_response status=403 tenant=acct-77 reason="Forbidden: client not authorized"
2026-03-23T01:02:11Z ERROR kms: verify failed key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd1234 err="signature does not match context"
```

carmen: Two hypotheses: (A) during client rotation the IdP reject list didn't include the new redirect or client id, leading to 403 on deprov; (B) our token signing context for extid changed because we rolled KMS key material and some tokens are still signed with previous context.

raj: Check the OIDC client config: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" https://idp.internal/api/clients/oidc-redwood` and confirm `client_id` and `active:true`. Also check `deploy/infra/keys/kms_alias` in the deployment that rolled last night.

anya: Fetching now. The idp client shows active=true but allowedOrigins includes staging but not the two affected tenant domains. Looks like a config drift in the client allowedOrigins during the automated rollout.

carmen: That explains the 403. For the KMS verify, run `scripts/kmstools/verify-context --key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd1234 --sample 10 --tenant acct-77` to see which context values are failing.

raj: Quick mitigation plan: 
1) Temporarily re-enable the old client_id/allowedOrigins or add the missing domains to the new client to clear 403s.
2) For KMS: add a verify fallback in the control plane so signature verify tries last 2 aliases for N days.
3) Pause deprov queue for affected tenants to avoid partial state: `POST /admin/queues/acct-77/pause`
4) Re-sign or rewrap extid tokens if contexts don't verify.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-79 | Priority: P2 | Owner: unassigned | Tags: oidc,scim,kms,rotation

anya: I'll open a quick rollback for the client allowedOrigins while we patch. Rolling back to prior client config now.

carmen: Also check provisioning_audit for recent role changes: `SELECT * FROM provisioning_audit WHERE tenant='acct-77' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50` to ensure we didn't accidentally deprovision resources.

raj: While rollback is in flight, run a targeted verify probe: `python tools/oidc_probe.py --tenant acct-77 --check-deprov --verbose` to simulate deprov and capture headers. If headers show `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error=\"invalid_client\"` then it's client auth on IdP side.

anya: Rollback applied at 01:15 UTC. Early checks show deprov 403s dropped to zero. KMS verify errors still 2/10 on sampled tokens.

carmen: For the remaining KMS failures, we should perform a rewrap of extid tokens that fail verify: `scripts/kmstools/rewrap --from-alias alias/old-rot --to-alias alias/new-rot --tenant acct-77 --dry-run` then `--apply` if green. Also add the alias-fallback code path (try verify with previous alias list) as a follow-up.

raj: Agreed. Also add postmortem items: 1) ensure OIDC client rollout includes allowedOrigins smoke-test against a tenant in every region, 2) KMS alias rotate must run tenant rewrap job or have an on-decrypt fallback attempt older aliases, 3) add an alert that surfaces when provisioning audit shows unusual deprov spikes after key/oidc rotations.

anya: Starting dry-run rewrap now (01:32 UTC). Will not resume deprov queue until rewrap verified.

ops-bot: Deprov queue paused for acct-77 at 2026-03-23T01:33:00Z.

carmen: Also a small note: when rewrapping extids check RBAC mapping normalization. Some tenants have case-insensitive extid normalization and rewrap can change the stored fingerprint leading to accidental role unbinds. Add a normalization check: `python tools/normalize_extid.py --tenant acct-77 --compare`

anya: Dry-run reports 38 items to rewrap, 0 failures. Kicking `--apply` now.

raj: Opening SOC ticket for audit traceability and notifying customer success to prep communications for impacted tenants.

carmen: Once done, we should publish a short runbook for oncall: how to triage after OIDC/KMS rotations (grep for 403 + "signature does not match context", check allowedOrigins, run rewrap probes).

anya: Rewrap finished at 01:48 UTC: 38 rewrapped, 0 errors. Resuming deprov queue.

ops-bot: Queue resume command accepted at 2026-03-23T01:49:05Z.

raj: Post-change metrics look healthy. No RBAC regressions in provisioning_audit. I'll draft the postmortem and RFC for alias-fallback.

anya: Thanks team. I'll update INC-2026-79 with steps and mark for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
